root_cause: Netlify production correctly remained on the latest deploy-applicable main ancestor because subsequent repository commits only touched paths intentionally excluded from website delivery. Treating repository HEAD and deploy-applicable website HEAD as identical would create false drift and unnecessary production rebuilds.
prevention: Preserve path-based deployment applicability for backend, governance, tests, learning and documentation-only changes.

When an exact-main production proof is explicitly required, use the existing website lane with one invisible index.html canary rather than broadening ignore rules or adding a second deployment authority.
Require exact protected merge SHA readback from Netlify production before claiming exact-main LIVE_PROVEN.
Close the proof with provider function inventory, secret-scan evidence, and Security Trust page/API readback in the same release lineage.
